title: Orchestrator decisions between steps
summary: A strong model chooses typed actions from bounded decision grounds at every transition and periodic intervention; guard rails signal, while mechanical checks preserve authority and finite execution. Replaces the deterministic AGT-3010 salvage framing.

implementationTasks.title: Decision grounds and shadow receipt
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Build DecisionGroundsV1 and OrchestratorDecisionReceiptV1 for one post-core transition in shadow mode. Read this Dossier, ADR-0032, the pipeline and token-pricing domain maps. Freeze typed inputs with source refs, freshness, omissions, alternatives, prior prediction/outcome, content digest and bounded pack; persist model/provider/thinking level, exact metered token categories, price status, reasoning, confidence and outcome link. Deduplicate usage by provider call id and keep unknown price explicit. No dispatch change. Acceptance: replay of the same occurrence yields one immutable receipt; a sample card has a one-click evidence ref; cached input and duplicate ledger fixtures do not inflate spend.

implementationTasks.title: Shared model decision and authority adapter
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and the ADR-0032 amendment proposal. Activate one post-core transition using a configurable strong model and the closed action union. The model chooses a typed action from offered alternatives; dispatch validates current fence, lease, exact SHA, autonomy class, security and gate floors through existing APIs. Record model-unavailable, quota, invalid-schema and forbidden-action cases as ask/hold receipts, with at most one configured alternate-model transport retry. Acceptance: a valid A1 choice dispatches once; stale authority, A2/A3 mutation, and unusable output cannot dispatch; every branch records an occurrence with tokens or an explicit no-call reason.

acceptanceScope.slice: Shared model decision and authority adapter

implementationTasks.title: Bounded artefact readers and loop signals
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier, Watcher evidence-pack contract and the existing loop inventory. Migrate orchestrator input assembly in supervision, abort review and multichat to bounded typed artefacts and immutable drill-down refs; no StepKind.Orchestrator prompt receives a raw session path or unbounded stream. Update all 13 inventory entries and their breaker tests so exhaustion raises a named signal and blocks re-entry pending model or human decision, without a counter choosing escalation. Acceptance: secret/oversize inputs have omission reasons, source digests survive log rotation, and each loop remains finite when the model is absent.

acceptanceScope.slice: Bounded artefact readers and loop signals

implementationTasks.title: Eight policy signals and emergency timeout
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier, runner and pipeline domain maps. Convert the eight listed policies to signal producers while retaining mechanical command/authority bounds. Carry the gate p95 and aspect derivation sentences into grounds. Resolve the coding emergency ceiling via project setting to workspace default to platform constant, default 24 hours; preserve timeout salvage ref/SHA and typed stop reason. Acceptance: a warning never chooses action, a hung process reaches the hard stop and salvage, and stale fence or runaway subprocess remains blocked.

acceptanceScope.slice: Eight policy signals and emergency timeout

implementationTasks.title: Transition visibility and decision economics
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and frontend AGENTS.md/design hard rules. Render each orchestrator occurrence between pipeline steps with one canonical primary blocker and one-click grounds/response/source evidence. Add deciding model to the bus producer and receipt projections. Show tokens, priced subtotal, unknown-price coverage and count by occurrence/card/project; include periodic occurrences. Acceptance: an escalated card has one correct statement above the pipeline, light/dark Playwright screenshots, model and cost reconcile to receipt, and no orchestrator cost is silently zero.

implementationTasks.title: ORCH-3 rules editor and periodic capacity seam
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and the Fluid capacity related card before implementation. Add API-owned immutable workspace rule versions and project overlays under .metadata, with actor/reason/diff/activation, dry-run replay and floor-refusal reasons. Support host-scoped periodic DecisionGroundsV1 with nullable card, configured model, full occurrence content/tokens/cost, and zero to three actions from the shared union; host-wide actions use workspace rules. Match Fluid capacity's 48 scheduled plus 12 event calls per host-day and 180,000 input/90,000 output token contingent; let that card own scheduling/allocation/utilization. Acceptance: version pin and rollback survive restart, dangerous edits are refused, dry run labels counterfactual model results, and a card-free capacity occurrence appears in host history and workspace roll-up.

acceptanceScope.slice: ORCH-3 rules editor and periodic capacity seam
